title: Updating a register in a seam configuration
statement: Let $l,l'$ be states, let $v$ assign a natural number to each of $m$ registers, let $\mathrm{out}$ be a Boolean word, let $r$ be a register, and let $n$ be a natural number. Replacing register $r$'s tape in the seam configuration determined by $l,v,\mathrm{out}$ with the binary word for $n$, setting its head to $0$, and changing the state to $(l',\mathrm{start})$ gives the seam configuration determined by $l'$, the function obtained from $v$ by setting $v(r)=n$, and the same output word.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ assigns a natural number to each of $m$ registers
